<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex6012024-09-1112-54-36" status="finalized">
   <note type="gloss">bzhi pa gzhan lugs dgag pa ni</note> | <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ref="db:3805" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">zhang tshes</rs> na re</note> so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo bzhan la gnod ba bzhi' dang bcas pa las ldog pa <lb edRef="inst:4477" n="23b6"/> tsam snyen gnas yan chad <note type="gloss">gcig</note> rten du yang dgos shing | theg pa gang dang yang mi 'gal ba de ni thun mong pa spyi yin la | so so 'i khyad par <note type="gloss">byang seMs kyi so sor thar pa</note> ni rgyun chags pa dang | gzhan rjes su bsrung pa dang | slar gso' bar rung pa <note type="gloss">yin pa</note> dang | de dag las ldog <note type="gloss">nyan thos kyi so sor thar pa yin</note> pa'i sgo nas tha dad pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
